questions.prompt: Name the main blood vessels that carry blood away from the heart.

autoMark.canonicalAnswer: Arteries carry blood away from the heart.
forbiddenMisconceptions: veins carry blood away from the heart
acceptedVariants: arteries carry blood away from the heart

questions.prompt: Name the vessels that carry blood towards the heart.

autoMark.canonicalAnswer: Veins carry blood towards the heart.
forbiddenMisconceptions: arteries carry blood towards the heart
acceptedVariants: veins carry blood towards the heart

questions.prompt: Where does exchange of substances between blood and tissues mainly occur?

autoMark.canonicalAnswer: In capillaries.

questions.prompt: What is the main function of red blood cells?

autoMark.canonicalAnswer: To transport oxygen (bound to haemoglobin).

questions.prompt: Give one function of white blood cells.

autoMark.canonicalAnswer: To defend against pathogens / produce antibodies.

questions.prompt: What is the role of platelets?

autoMark.canonicalAnswer: Platelets help blood clot at a wound.

questions.prompt: Which side of the heart pumps deoxygenated blood to the lungs?

autoMark.canonicalAnswer: The right ventricle (via pulmonary artery).
forbiddenMisconceptions: left side pumps to the lungs
acceptedVariants: right side of the heart to the lungs

questions.prompt: Which vessel carries deoxygenated blood from the heart to the lungs?

autoMark.canonicalAnswer: The pulmonary artery.
forbiddenMisconceptions: pulmonary vein carries deoxygenated blood to the lungs

questions.prompt: Which vessel brings oxygenated blood from the lungs to the heart?

autoMark.canonicalAnswer: The pulmonary vein.
forbiddenMisconceptions: pulmonary artery brings oxygenated blood to the heart

questions.prompt: What prevents backflow of blood in the veins?

autoMark.canonicalAnswer: Valves in veins.

questions.prompt: Why do arteries have thick muscular walls?

autoMark.canonicalAnswer: To withstand high pressure from ventricular contraction.

questions.prompt: Why are capillary walls only one cell thick?

autoMark.canonicalAnswer: Short diffusion distance for faster exchange.

questions.prompt: Name the chamber of the heart that receives oxygenated blood from the lungs.

autoMark.canonicalAnswer: Left atrium.
forbiddenMisconceptions: right atrium receives oxygenated blood from the lungs

questions.prompt: Which heart chamber pumps oxygenated blood to the body?

autoMark.canonicalAnswer: Left ventricle.
forbiddenMisconceptions: right ventricle pumps oxygenated blood to the body
acceptedVariants: left ventricle pumps blood to the body

questions.prompt: What carries electrical signals across the heart to coordinate contraction?

autoMark.canonicalAnswer: Specialised muscle tissue / conducting system (SAN, AVN).

questions.prompt: In a closed double circulation, name the two circuits.

autoMark.canonicalAnswer: Pulmonary and systemic.

questions.prompt: Why is the left ventricle wall thicker than the right?

autoMark.canonicalAnswer: It pumps blood at higher pressure around the whole body.

questions.prompt: What is the main component of blood plasma?

autoMark.canonicalAnswer: Water.
forbiddenMisconceptions: cells are the main component of plasma

questions.prompt: State one adaptation of red blood cells for oxygen transport.

autoMark.canonicalAnswer: Biconcave shape / large surface area; contains haemoglobin.
acceptedVariants: large surface area to volume ratio

questions.prompt: Why are valves important in veins but not needed in the same way in arteries?

autoMark.canonicalAnswer: Veins are low pressure; blood can flow backwards without valves. Arteries have high pressure from the heart.
acceptedVariants: veins have low pressure so valves stop backflow
